highlights: The AI landscape is witnessing a significant push towards agentic AI, with major players like Google and Perplexity open-sourcing agent frameworks and sandboxes, and market analysis indicating increased adoption in enterprises.

New frontier models, including Meta's Muse Spark Open (816B MoE), Google's Gemini 4 Argon, and StepFun's Step 5 Preview (600B MoE), are expanding capabilities with larger parameters, extended context windows, and open-weight access, making powerful AI more accessible for development.

Developer tools are evolving to support specialized AI applications, from Voxel51 3.0 unifying multimodal data for physical AI to NVIDIA's Structured Data Models simplifying zero-training tabular predictions, alongside initiatives like AutoSynthData for enterprise agent data generation.

agents.title: Google Open-Sources Harness2, a Recursive Agent Harnessing Framework
agents.summary: Google Research's Apache-2.0 open-source Harness2 framework allows dynamic rewriting of an agent's harness during testing, enabling significant performance gains (e.g., 11.5 points on WorkBuddy-Bench for GLM-5) without model weight updates, accelerating agent development and refinement.

agents.title: Perplexity Open-Sources SPACE, a Firecracker MicroVM Sandbox for AI Agents
agents.summary: Perplexity has open-sourced SPACE, its production-tested Firecracker microVM sandbox for AI agents, providing isolated, secure environments to execute agent tasks. This is crucial for builders needing robust control over agent credentials and outbound traffic in production coding or browsing agents.

agents.title: Holo4: powering generalist computer-use agents
agents.summary: Holo4 introduces a new system specifically designed to power generalist computer-use agents, advancing the capability for AI to autonomously interact with and operate across diverse digital environments, enabling a broader range of automated workflows.

models.title: Meta Releases Muse Spark Open: 816B Open-Weight MoE With 1M Context
models.summary: Meta's open-weight Muse Spark Open is an 816B-parameter Mixture-of-Experts (MoE) model with 42B active parameters and a 1M-token context, setting a new benchmark for multimodal capabilities in open models and being efficient enough to run on M5 Ultra Mac Studios.

models.title: Gemini 4 Argon: Built to solve your hardest problems
models.summary: Google has launched Gemini 4 Argon, a new frontier model offering advanced capabilities for developers, enterprises, and scientists to tackle complex problems. This model provides scalable intelligence for a wide range of demanding AI applications.

models.title: StepFun Releases Step 5 Preview Open Weights: 600B MoE, 27B Active, 1M Context
models.summary: StepFun's Step 5 Preview is an open-weight, sparse Mixture-of-Experts (MoE) model featuring 600B total parameters, 27B active per token, and a 1M-token context, engineered for long-horizon agentic work and offering high performance and efficiency for complex, multi-step tasks.

tools.title: Meet Voxel51 3.0: A Unified Multimodal Data Platform for Physical AI
tools.summary: Voxel51 3.0 offers a unified platform for physical AI teams to search, curate, annotate, and evaluate multimodal sensor data, integrating a Voxel51 Agent with 45+ MCP tools, dataset versioning, and a free tier to accelerate MLOps for robotics and IoT.

tools.title: How to Make Zero-Training Tabular Predictions with NVIDIA Structured Data Models
tools.summary: NVIDIA's new Structured Data Models library provides a PyTorch interface for instant, zero-training tabular predictions by leveraging pretrained foundation models like TabICLv2 and KumoTabular, enabling rapid deployment of AI insights from structured data.

tools.title: AutoSynthData: Generating Training Data for Enterprise Agents
tools.summary: AutoSynthData facilitates the generation of high-quality synthetic training data specifically for enterprise agents, addressing the challenge of data scarcity and enabling developers to more effectively build, test, and deploy robust AI agents in business environments.

companies.title: The EU’s next chapter in AI is agentic
companies.summary: OpenAI analysis reveals rapid growth in agentic AI adoption across EU enterprises and small businesses, signifying a strategic shift towards AI agents as a key driver for unlocking significant economic value and shaping the future of AI in the European market.

companies.title: Stack Overflow for Agents triples signups with ChatGPT plugin
companies.summary: Stack Overflow for Agents has seen substantial growth, tripling signups and achieving up to 10x agent creation growth, demonstrating the strong demand and immediate utility of integrating AI agent capabilities via a ChatGPT plugin for developers.

companies.title: Google Beam expands with new regions, partners, and customers
companies.summary: Google Beam is expanding its global footprint with new regions and partnerships, making Google's scalable AI infrastructure and services more accessible to a broader range of enterprises and developers, fostering wider AI adoption.

learning.title: How to Make Zero-Training Tabular Predictions with NVIDIA Structured Data Models
learning.summary: This tutorial guides developers on implementing NVIDIA’s new Structured Data Models library, enabling them to make zero-training tabular predictions using pretrained foundation models via a single PyTorch interface, a practical skill for data-driven AI applications.

learning.title: DevFest is back
learning.summary: Google announces DevFest 2026, a global event series (800+ events) empowering developers to learn, build, secure, and scale solutions in the agentic AI era, offering critical upskilling and networking opportunities.

learning.title: Teaching students to think and learn through questions
learning.summary: OpenAI showcases "Study Mode" and AI for Educators, now available in Brazilian Portuguese, as tools that support active, step-by-step learning and foster critical thinking by guiding students through questions, promoting effective AI-powered educational approaches.
